{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates
print("Number of duplicate rows:", trial_df.duplicated().sum())

# Check for missing values
print("Missing values per column:\n", trial_df.isnull().sum())

# Check the distribution of the 'arm' column
print("\nDistribution of arm:", trial_df['arm'].value_counts())

# Check the distribution of 'responded' by arm
print("\nResponse rates by arm:\n", trial_df.groupby('arm')['responded'].mean())"}
